LESSON: PLANE GEOMETRY (INSTRUMENTS USED IN DRAWING, LAYOUT OF A DRAWING ENVIRONMENT, CONSTRUCT COMBINED SHAPES)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT ENGLISH
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.1: Plane Geometry (instruments used in drawing, layout of a drawing environment, construct combined shapes)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Plane Geometry (instruments used in drawing, layout of a drawing environment, construct combined shapes), part of Communication in Pre-Technical Studies in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How are combined shapes applied in day-to- day life? 2. How can understanding geometric shapes support creative design solutions in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Plane Geometry (instruments used in drawing, layout of a drawing environment, construct combined shapes) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: The learner acquires team working skills when practising how to make combined

shapes in plane geometry.

● Learning to learn: The learner develops organising skills when drawing combined shapes.

Values:
● Responsibility: The learner develops accountability as they engage in assigned roles and duties during group activities like

discussions and presentations on drawing combined shapes in plane geometry.

● Respect: The learner develops open mindedness as they appreciate diverse opinions when discussing how to draw

combined shapes.

Link to other subjects:

● Mathematics: The learner applies the construction skills learnt in mathematics as they perform geometrical construction.

22

● Kenya sign language: The learner applies the signing skills learnt in KSL as they fingerspell and sign terminologies

related to plane geometry.
